src: The Hirout Party (Hebrew: حزب حيروت أي "Freedom"), full name "Hirout Movement of the Establishment of the Aitzel", is a Zionist political party founded by members of the Aitzel (Organization of Ergon) under the leadership of Menachem Begin immediately after the establishment of the State of Israel in 1948 in Palestine. src: Although the Bible does not mention a date or date of Jesus' birth, the Church Fathers have determined since the Council of Nicaea in 325 that date, as well as the ecclesiastical tradition has listed it as midnight. src: A distribution list is a term used to define a mechanism of e-mail (e-mail) mechanisms where a group of e-mail addresses share in a single list where each member of the group consists of sending e-mail to all members of the group at the same time.
